hadi-march/managers#audit.name: audit
hadi-march/managers#audit.doc: Common problems under `root`: no alt, no accessible name, no label, duplicate ids, positive tabindex, skipped heading levels, focusable content inside aria-hidden. Not a replacement for a full audit tool.
hadi-march/managers#audit.tr: `root` altındaki yaygın sorunlar: alt metin yok, erişilebilir ad yok, etiket yok, yinelenen kimlikler, pozitif tabindex, atlanmış başlık düzeyleri, aria-hidden içinde odaklanabilir içerik. Tam bir denetim aracının yerini tutmaz.

hadi-march/managers#beaconTransport.name: beaconTransport
hadi-march/managers#beaconTransport.doc: Batches entries and posts them with navigator.sendBeacon (fetch keepalive as fallback): every `interval` ms, when `batch` entries wait, and when the tab is hidden. `allow` gates sending (e.g. analytics consent); while it says no, nothing leaves the device and the queue is dropped.
hadi-march/managers#beaconTransport.signature: function beaconTransport(url: string, o: { batch?: number; interval?: number; minLevel?: Level; allow?: () => boolean; send?: (url: string, body: string) => boolean } = {}): Transport & { queued(): number }

params.name: o
params.type: { batch?: number; interval?: number; minLevel?: Level; allow?: () => boolean; send?: (url: string, body: string) => boolean }

hadi-march/managers#beaconTransport.tr: Girdileri toplu halde biriktirir ve navigator.sendBeacon ile gönderir (yedek olarak fetch keepalive): her `interval` ms'de, `batch` girdi bekleyince ve sekme gizlenince. `allow` gönderimi denetler (örn. analitik onayı).

hadi-march/managers#consent.doc: The consent manager. Every method goes to the one instance (created on first use).
hadi-march/managers#consent.value:
{
  has: (c) => manager.get().has(c),
  decided: () => manager.get().decided(),
  record: () => manager.get().record(),
  choices: () => manager.get().choices(),
  categories: () => manager.get().categories(),
  policyHref: () => manager.get().policyHref(),
  acceptAll: () => manager.get().acceptAll(),
  rejectAll: () => manager.get().rejectAll(),
  save: (c) => manager.get().save(c),
  withdraw: () => manager.get().withdraw(),
  on: (c, fn) => manager.get().on(c, fn),
  gate: (c, fn) => (...a) => manager.get().gate(c, fn)(...a),
  whenGranted: (c, s) => manager.get().whenGranted(c, s),
  granted: (c) => manager.get().granted(c),
  dispose: () => manager.dispose(),
}
hadi-march/managers#consent.tr: Onay yöneticisi. Her yöntem tek örneğe gider (ilk kullanımda oluşturulur).

props.name: always
props.doc: Show even when a decision is already stored (demos); a choice made on the banner still closes it.

props.name: inline
props.doc: Render in place, in the page flow, instead of the bottom layer (demos).

props.name: customize
props.doc: The Customize button that opens the preferences panel. Default true. Reject and Accept always stay, side by side.

props.name: text
props.doc: Banner text: the app's own wording (its legal text).

props.name: policyLabel
props.doc: Label of the policy link (shown when configureConsent({ policyHref }) is set).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts for the buttons and the preferences panel.

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#ConsentBa.tr: Alt şerit; geçerli politika sürümü için geçerli bir karar yokken gösterilir.

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#ConsentGa.name: ConsentGate

props.name: label
props.doc: What the placeholder says (default: a generic "This content is blocked" text).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts for the placeholder's buttons (`allow`, `preferences`) and for the panel it opens.

props.name: preferences
props.doc: The Preferences button of the placeholder. Default true.

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#ConsentGa.tr: Alt öğelerini yalnız `category` verilmişken çizer; aksi halde yerinde izin verilebilen bir yer tutucu gösterir.
